build_recipe.rationale: This build recipe synthesizes the successful setup trajectory for the digital-cousins repository. The key challenges were: (1) robomimic couldn't be installed via git+https due to network issues, so git clone + pip install /tmp/robomimic was used instead; (2) OmniGibson has heavy GPU-dependent dependencies (Isaac Gym, CUDA, etc.) that can't be installed in a standard Docker container, so a comprehensive stub package was built to provide the required import interfaces, then the actual OmniGibson package was installed with --no-deps; (3) bddl needed a predicates stub with 82 predicate classes and a KnowledgeBase alias because OmniGibson's bddl_utils.py imports these; (4) lerobot also couldn't be installed via git+https due to network issues, so a comprehensive stub was built; (5) several apt packages for OpenGL support were needed for opencv-python. The recipe preserves the exact order of successful state-changing commands and avoids all the failed attempts, intermediate debugging steps, and read-only exploration. All file patches are consolidated into a single Python script that writes the predicates stub and patches the knowledge_base and robots __init__ files in one step. The test command verifies all 12 tests can be collected.
